title: Server business-data cross-reference (stditem/monster/magic/Mapinfo/Merchant) vs EI 3.0 client UI field consumption

source.warning: All server .dat rows are DERIVED: server business data is not client primary evidence. Server rows that contradict client facts are recorded in conflict_notes and never silently picked. Client-side byte/state evidence remains primary for rendering semantics.

stditem.loader_proof: GetMem(0xB8=184); seek(idx*0xB8+4); xor-4 helper 0x4957A4 @ 0x4957CC; constant also 0x4953CC

monster.loader_proof: read 4-byte count; GetMem(0xFC=252); seek(idx*0xFC+4); xor-9 helper 0x495C4C @ 0x495C74
monster.id_proof: ID dword @248 == rec_index+1 for all verified rows (稻草人 rec65->66, 钉耙猫 71->72, 多钩猫 80->81, 蛤蟆 93->94, 鸡 132->133, 鹿 233->235, 牛老道 246->248, 羊 401->403, 白野猪 27->28); sequential type ids

dat_layout_ground_truth.decode_recipe: leading 4-byte count dword is RAW; body bytes are XOR'd byte-wise with the per-file single-byte key; then fixed-size records; names are GBK ShortStrings (len byte + bytes).

counts.monster_tail_short: final record truncated by exactly 4 bytes = its ID dword @248..251; 432 full records + one 248-byte record decoded

conflict_notes.note: Market_Def/[Goods] header comment is ';ItemName Volume Hour', so '金创药（小） 2000 1' = stock volume 2000 + restock hour 1, NOT a price. stditem price144 = real price (金创药小 80). Old '2000 vs 80' conflict removed.
牛老道 d52=1 breaks the HP-like hypothesis for d52 (its d56=1200 is the plausible HP). d52/d56 both stay candidate until a runtime HP capture resolves which field is true HP.
No map id 544 exists in Mapinfo.txt; 544 = client Map/ dir FILE COUNT (matches survey Finding 242). Mapinfo stems are strings, not numeric ids.

d72 is 1 for consumables (weight candidate), 4000-20000 for equipment (durability-like candidate), 7/8/29 for spellbooks (spell-id-coded candidate). Cannot be a single semantic without runtime capture.
d24 = 2 for 爆裂火焰/冰咆哮 but 5 for 冰沙掌/乾坤大挪移/斗转星移 and 1 for 冰月神掌/冰月震天 -- not a clean element code (ice spells split 1/2/5). Level-requirement candidate remains.
monster.dat body 109112B = 432*252 + 248B; the final record is truncated by exactly its ID dword @248..251. All 432 full records decode; header count 433 includes the truncated tail.

Selector element 82 (0x5668C4) path slot 0x56F944+12*0x104 is bss-filled at runtime (ctor 0x452AA0 loop2 binds elements 70..139; path slots filled by 0x452B20-style string copies). Static WIL filename for el82 unproven; empirical pixel-identity evidence points to StoreItem.wil (identical art to Ground.wil at Looks 940..1044; 1440 frames covers Looks range).

Every client<-server field link above is derived: the server .dat values are business data; only the client-side consumption addresses (selector contexts, literal strings, gauge routines) are primary-static client evidence.
